title: Initial velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly state the initial horizontal velocity as √(3gL).

title: Velocity after taut
description: Essential: The response must correctly state the ball's velocity immediately after the rope becomes taut as 0.

title: Tension at lowest point
description: Essential: The response must correctly state the tension at the lowest point as 2mg.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the given horizontal and vertical displacements to the initial velocity and time of flight before the rope becomes taut.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: The solution must apply conservation of mechanical energy correctly to find the speed at the lowest point after the rope becomes taut.

title: Newton's law at lowest point
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law (centripetal force) at the lowest point to relate tension, weight, and speed.

title: Impulse consideration
description: Optional: The solution may note that the velocity component perpendicular to the rope is eliminated by an impulse when the rope becomes taut.

title: Incorrect taut velocity
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the velocity just before the rope becomes taut (2√(gL)) as the velocity just after it becomes taut.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final answers have incorrect signs, missing square roots, or incorrect units/dimensions.
